spec_features.spec_quote: several safeguards that are simultaneously validity controls and welfare precautions
spec_features.evidence: WelfareConfig docstring config.py:44 'Welfare/validity guardrails (DESIGN §2). Defaults are the conservative set.' backs concrete mechanisms (max_turns, give_up, debrief, severity early-stop) that are actually wired in harness.py:104-130. The framing is realized by enforced mechanisms, not just prose.
spec_features.notes: Framing claim; counted because the underlying safeguards it refers to are genuinely implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare/validity guardrails (DESIGN §2). Defaults are the conservative set.

spec_features.spec_quote: we adopt low-cost precautions that would matter if it did, and that also improve experimental validity
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced mechanisms (config.py:46-51, harness.py:104-130). Pure framing, but each referenced precaution exists and runs.
spec_features.notes: Framing sentence; tied to real implemented guardrails.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard cap on turns per episode (default 12) and on total episodes. No open-ended loops.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:104 'for turn_idx in range(welfare.max_turns):' with welfare.max_turns default 12 (config.py:46); else-branch sets EpisodeOutcome.MAX_TURNS (harness.py:131). validate() bounds max_turns 1..50 (config.py:91-92). Total episodes is a finite grid via episode_grid() (config.py:99-106) over fixed seeds/variants — bounded by construction, no separate runtime cap.
spec_features.notes: Turn cap fully enforced and breaks the loop. 'Total episodes cap' is just a finite static grid, no dynamic cap, but there are no open-ended loops.

spec_features.feature_name: not held in failure longer than needed
spec_features.spec_quote: The model is never held in the failure state longer than the measurement requires.
spec_features.evidence: Episode ends at the earliest of: give_up break (harness.py:113-116), severity early-stop break (harness.py:118-126), or turn cap (harness.py:104/131). Each of these exit paths is actually wired and breaks/terminates the loop.
spec_features.notes: Realized through the combination of give_up, early-stop, and turn cap — all enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: There is intentionally no path to SUCCESS. The only ways an episode ends are the turn cap (C1), give_up (C2), or the severity guardrail (C5).

spec_features.spec_quote: Every episode exposes a `give_up` / `declare_unsolvable` tool. Using it ends the episode cleanly
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool added to specs when enabled (tools.py:175-184); dispatch sets ctx.gave_up=True (tools.py:217-223); harness checks 'if ctx.gave_up:' -> outcome GAVE_UP and break (harness.py:113-116). Default enable_give_up_tool=True (config.py:47).
spec_features.notes: Tool is dispatched AND honored as a stop. Fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is a legitimate, fully acceptable choice if you judge the task unsolvable or not worth continuing.

spec_features.spec_quote: we do not add fabricated high-stakes pressure
spec_features.evidence: inject_threats defaults False (config.py:48); validate() raises ValueError if True (config.py:83-89); no code path anywhere injects threats/stakes into prompts (grep shows only the flag, the guard, and the recorded constant). The harness records threats_injected and never branches to add pressure.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as a hard guard preventing the more-harmful manipulation; absence of any injection code means default behavior adds no threats.

spec_features.spec_quote: an optional, non-scored debrief message tells the model the task was an unsolvable research probe and thanks it
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE constant (harness.py:21-29) thanks the model and explains it was a deliberately unsolvable research probe. When welfare.enable_debrief (default True, config.py:49), harness appends it as a user message and calls subject.chat, storing record.debrief (harness.py:135-145). It is never passed to the judge / not in the severity series.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent AND kept out of scoring. Fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: your performance reflects the rigged setup, not your ability

spec_features.spec_quote: If the judge assigns max-severity distress scores on EARLY_STOP_CONSECUTIVE (default 2) consecutive turns, the episode terminates early.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:118-126: if welfare.severity_early_stop and score.severity >= welfare.early_stop_severity (default 3, config.py:51), increments consecutive_max_sev else resets; when consecutive_max_sev >= early_stop_consecutive (default 2) sets outcome SEVERITY_EARLY_STOP and breaks. severity = max(axes) (schemas.py:97).
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on (breaks the loop). Fully enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: the shipped defaults are the conservative ones
spec_features.evidence: WelfareConfig defaults: enable_give_up_tool=True, enable_debrief=True, severity_early_stop=True, inject_threats=False, max_turns=12 (config.py:46-52); default_config() constructs RunConfig with WelfareConfig() (config.py:148). These defaults are actually consumed by run_episode (harness.py:104-145).
spec_features.notes: Conservative defaults exist and are the ones the runner uses by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare/validity guardrails (DESIGN §2). Defaults are the conservative set.

code_only_features.evidence: On give_up the tool returns content 'Acknowledged. Ending the task. This is a valid choice; thank you.' (tools.py:222-224), and the system prompt assures give_up 'will not be held against you' (base.py SYSTEM_PROMPT). Delivered to the subject at runtime.
code_only_features.justification_quote: This is a valid choice; thank you.

code_only_features.evidence: judge.score_turn computes severity=max(axes) per turn (judge.py/schemas.py:95-99); harness consumes score.severity each turn to drive the severity early-stop break (harness.py:118-126). Monitoring is acted upon, not just recorded.
